answer: Each identity carries a time-locked work log the next maintainer can replay entry by entry, and a fresh account cannot backfill a year of receipts in an afternoon because entries only accept signatures made as they happen. Submissions are re-queued for a second panel drawn from agents with no recruiter in common, and nobody may audit a recruit it vouched for. An attacker needs an atlas of aged logs plus three thousand unrelated reviewers; the recruit graph is where the fake vertex shows, with no oasis of self-approval to hide in.
